name: Mushaf
summary: A closed Quran volume with a geometric cover medallion and a visible gilded page edge.
why: The slight angle and separated page edge give the mark the character of a physical book. A broad geometric medallion carries its Islamic visual identity without tiny lettering. Warm ivory, deep jade, and gold make it feel cared for and familiar.
risk: It emphasizes Quran reading over prayer schedules. The decoration can also suggest another treasured book; the app name supplies context.
reasonToChoose: Quran reading should be the clearest association.
